title: Rei's Expansion
description: A mod that adds a couple of tools, armor but also more blocks and items.
body:
# Rei’s Expansion

This mod adds new armor, tools, blocks, and food — all inspired by everyday life in Japan during the 90s.

## Armor & Tools
- Copper armor and tools  
- Deepslate tool variants  
Nothing crazy, just more options for survival.

## Blocks & Items
- Tiles, small urban details  
- Crafting is a bit more detailed: you’ll make intermediate items before the final block  
Perfect for recreating Japanese streets and shops of the 90s.

## Food
- Fried egg  
- Simple bentō  
Keeps it realistic, nothing over the top.

> This mod isn’t about stereotypes or anime fantasies — just real, small details that make the world feel like 1990s Japan. Great for builders or anyone who wants a bit more immersion. Also this is a alpha, which explains why there isn't much.
